Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the documentation match the results originally recorded in the implementation. Key matches include: (1) 48% of relations achieving >60% faithfulness verified against Table 10 showing 22/46 relations; (2) R=0.84 correlation between faithfulness and causality confirmed in Figure 6; (3) Company CEO <6% faithfulness matches Table 10 value of 0.06±0.03; (4) Attribute lens 54-63% R@1 recovery matches Table 3; (5) Cross-model correlations R=0.85 and R=0.71 match Figure 16.
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: All steps from the final plan are reflected in the implementation. The methodology steps (LRE extraction with mean Jacobian n=8, faithfulness evaluation, causality evaluation with inverse LRE, testing on GPT-J/GPT-2-XL/LLaMA-13B) are implemented in src/operators.py (JacobianIclMeanEstimator) and demo/demo.ipynb. All six planned experiments (faithfulness, causality, layer-wise, baselines, attribute lens, cross-model) are present in notebooks/figures/ and demo/ directories.
Rationale.CS3_Effect_Size: The reported effects have clearly non-trivial magnitudes relative to baselines. LRE faithfulness exceeds best baseline by 15-40 percentage points (50-70% vs 20-35%). LRE causality matches oracle baseline (60-95% vs 65-98%) and exceeds other baselines by 25-50+ pp. Attribute lens shows 51-60 pp improvement on distracted prompts (2-3% to 54-63%). Cross-model correlations are strong (R=0.71-0.85).
Rationale.CS4_Justification: All key design choices have explicit justifications: (1) n=8 examples justified by GPU memory constraints and performance plateau (Section 4, Figure 12); (2) β=2.25 scaling justified by measured underestimation ratio 2.5-4.3x (Appendix C, Tables 5-6); (3) Low-rank pseudoinverse justified by ill-conditioned full inverse (Appendix D.2, Figure 9); (4) Layer selection justified by enrichment/mode-switch pattern (Section 4.3, Figure 7). Intermediate conclusions are supported by quantitative evidence with success rates above 80% where applicable.
Rationale.CS5_Statistical_Significance: Key experimental results report appropriate uncertainty measures. Table 10 reports mean ± stdev for faithfulness and causality across 24 trials. Tables 4, 6, 7 similarly report mean ± std. Correlation coefficients (R=0.84, R=0.85, R=0.71) are provided for key claims. The AggregateMetric class in src/metrics.py computes mean, stdev, stderr. Variability captures variation across different random sets of training examples. Limitations are acknowledged in Appendix I with first-token collision rates quantified in Table 9.
